description_en: Queries the download URL of the results of a database export ticket
description_zh: 调用GetDbExportDownloadURL接口，获取数据库导出结果附件下载地址
name: GetDbExportDownloadURL

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户的ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to obtain the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

DownloadURLResult.description_en: The download URL of the exported file

HasResult.description_en:
Indicates whether export results are available for download. Valid values:

true: Export results are available for download.
false: No export results are available for download
HasResult.description_zh:
是否有下载结果，返回值如下：
true：有下载结果。
false：没有下载结果

TipMessage.description_en: The message that indicates an exception

URL.description_en: The download URL of the exported file

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
